And we’re proud to say that we’re doing our bit to help the planet by reducing our carbon footprint. Wednesday’s Domaine is all about modern wine for modern times, crafting beautifully balanced wines at a lighter 6.5% ABV without compromising on flavour. Doré is a golden-hued Chardonnay bursting with citrus and tropical fruit notes, finishing crisp and refreshing on the palate. For something pink, Aprèm is made for leisurely afternoons, with delicate red fruit flavours and bright acidity creating an elegant, easy-drinking rosé. Whether you’re catching up with friends in the sunshine or settling in for a leisurely meal, these lower-alcohol wines are the perfect pour. Mouth-watering Sunday Roasts Sunday’s at the Cutty Sark are all about perfect roasts. We are talking plates piled high with succulent meats, vibrant veggies, golden roasties, Yorkshire puddings risen to perfection, and an abundance of rich, velvety gravy. For those who can’t resist a bit on the side enjoy creamy cauliflower cheese and delightful pigs in blankets. And to add a spicy twist to your Sunday, don’t miss our perfectly crafted Bloody Marys. Join us this Sunday for an indulgent roast. Book Now Great British Menus Ahoy there! At The Cutty Sark, we’ve got a spread of locally-sourced and seasonal dishes to tickle your taste buds, matey. From hearty pub classics to our expertly crafted seafood dishes, there’s something for everyone. Our skilled crew of chefs have put together a menu full of flavor, using the freshest ingredients to whip up traditional dishes with a modern twist. Whether you’re after a light lunch or a filling dinner, we’ve got you covered, me hearties.
